items.s: McPherson did not attempt a field goal and made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over Baltimore. McPherson and the rest of the Bengals were blanked before halftime, but the kicker was able to finish off five touchdown drives in the second half. McPherson has now attempted one or zero field goals in three straight games after opening the season with multiple field-goal makes in each of the team's first three contests.

items.h: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 7 win
items.s: Evan McPherson connected on all five of his extra point attempts in a 35-13 win over the Ravens. McPherson was not asked to attempt a field goal, but was perfect after all five Bengals' touchdowns. The 27-year-old kicker has yet to miss an attempt this season an will look to continue that in Week 7 against the Titans.

items.h: Evan McPherson Could Get Lots Of Opportunities In Week 7
items.s: Cincinnati Bengals kicker Evan McPherson will face the Baltimore Ravens on the road in Week 7. McPherson is fresh off his team's bye week and should be ready to extend his streak. McPherson could be called upon often in this week's game against the Ravens. The Baltimore offense is one of the best units in the league with quarterback Lamar Jackson at the helm and this contest could very well be the highest-scoring game of the week. McPherson made his lone field-goal attempt and all four of his extra-point tries during the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. McPherson was mostly limited to point-after tries thanks to four touchdown passes by Joe Burrow, but the former connected on a 26-yard chip shot late in the fourth quarter to extend Cincinnati's lead to 31-18. McPherson has attempted only one field goal in each of his last two games, but his scoring floor remains elevated on a week-to-week basis so long as the Bengals' offense under Burrow continues to move the ball down field. Cincinnati is on a bye for Week 6 before welcoming in Baltimore for Week 7 on Sunday, Oct. 25.

items.h: Evan McPherson scores seven points Sunday
items.s: Evan McPherson went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins. McPherson did his job on Sunday, making all five of his kicks in a win over the Dolphins. He should continue to be a good fantasy option moving forward after the team's bye week in Week 6.

items.h: Evan McPherson perfect in loss Sunday
items.s: Evan McPherson went 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars. McPherson played pretty well on Sunday. He did his job and made all three of his kicks over the course of the afternoon, but Cincinnati still suffered a loss at the hands of the Jaguars. He should continue to be a pretty solid fantasy option at the position moving forward.

McPherson made his only field-goal attempt and both of his PATs during Sunday's 22-17 loss to Jacksonville. McPherson was unable to make it four straight games with multiple field-goal makes, converting his only attempt of the day from 29 yards in the second quarter. The kicker is still perfect on the season, going 9-for-9 on field-goal tries, including five makes from 50-plus yards, over four contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

items.h: Evan McPherson Should Be A Strong Play In Week 4
items.s: Cincinnati Bengals kicker Evan McPherson had another strong performance in last week's 27-30 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. The Bengals kicker is yet to miss a single kick this season and should have more opportunities to score this weekend against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
